name: Wes Moore

lean.basis: Democratic governor of Maryland since 2023; Democratic National Convention keynote speaker and Biden-Harris surrogate in 2024.

sources.title: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore rules out presidential run — NBC News

source.title: File:Wes Moore Official Governor Portrait.jpg — Wikimedia Commons

summary: Wes Moore (born 1978), an Army veteran, Rhodes Scholar, author of The Other Wes Moore and former CEO of the Robin Hood Foundation, became Maryland's first Black governor in 2023. A 2024 convention keynote speaker often named as a 2028 prospect, he ruled out a presidential run in September 2025 while feuding with Trump over sending the National Guard to Baltimore; Wikipedia reports he won a second term in November 2026.

sources.title: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore rules out presidential run — NBC News

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: In 2025 Trump threatened to send the National Guard into Baltimore to fight crime; Moore said homicides were at historic lows, the Guard was unnecessary, and he would accept FBI and ATF help instead.
